summary: All 4 new features verified end-to-end. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass (25 previous regression + 12 new). New tests cover (1) multi-week generate: admin creates N consecutive weeks Mon–Sat filled with rotation alternation confirmed via GET /api/schedule/{week} (monday first-shift person flips P/M every week), count clamps at 12, non-admin -> 403; (2) settings times & personColors: PUT admin persists times/colors/vehicle/reportGroupLink/autoGenerateWeeks; /api/people and /api/summary/{week} return the updated personColors; non-admin PUT -> 403; (3) vehicle location: unauth POST -> 401, auth POST 201 with body echo, /latest exists=true reflects last point, /history is chronological (oldest first) and clamps to 500; (4) shift swaps: employee with personKey P proposes -> 201 pending, employee with different personKey proposing same shift -> 403, duplicate pending -> 409, accepting own -> 400, GET /api/swaps requires auth, another user accepts -> shift.person becomes accepter's personKey and swap.status='accepted', owner can cancel (cancelled swaps excluded from GET list). Frontend (mobile 390x844): admin login OK; Home shows open-zarobki + open-zamiany; Grafik shows open-swaps and generate sheet with gen-count-1/2/4/8 chips + gen-confirm — triggering '2 weeks' produced 'Wygenerowano 2 tygodni' toast and week grid populates with TEST P / TEST M; Swaps screen renders with back-btn and shows accepted proposals from backend tests (Przejęta chip); Auto tab shows loc-status (Aktywny, 36 km/h), share-card, toggle-share, 4 route history points and coordinates 52.20000, 21.10000 (web map fallback as expected); Ustawienia edit-config-btn opens sheet with cfg-s1/e1/s2/e2, cfg-vehicle, cfg-save + 12 color swatches (cfg-color-P-* / M / L variants) and saving showed 'Zapisano konfigurację' toast.

issues: Non-blocking console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (react-native-web dependency). Same as iteration 1.

action_items: Optional (carryover): silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_multi correctly clamps count to 1..12 and alternates rotation on odd indices only when alternateRotation=true — verified.
location POST requires auth, GET latest/history are public via optional_user — matches spec. history sorted desc then reversed to be chronological (oldest first).
swaps: create_swap blocks non-owner (person mismatch) with 403, dedupes pending with 409, accept blocks own proposer with 400, cancelled swaps are excluded from GET /api/swaps — all confirmed.

get_settings_doc bootstraps DEFAULT_TIMES['10'] and WORKER_COLORS. Note: if admin only stores partial times dict, later reads pass through as-is. Consider validating shape server-side (currently Pydantic dict is untyped).
server.py is 761 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, users, schedule, swaps, location, settings) in a follow-up.

Warning: PytestRemovedIn10Warning on class-scoped fixture defined as instance method in TestSwaps.env — cosmetic only; tests still deterministic because env is scope='class'. Can migrate to @classmethod set on cls in future.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed employees (test_swap_P_*, test_swap_M_*, test_emp_*) via admin POST /api/users and register. Weeks are chosen far into the future to avoid collision. Location and swap records left in DB (small, harmless).

Frontend testIDs for new features: open-zarobki, open-zamiany, open-swaps, gen-count-{1,2,4,8}, gen-confirm, back-btn, loc-status, share-card, toggle-share, edit-config-btn, cfg-s1/e1/s2/e2, cfg-vehicle, cfg-save, cfg-color-{P,M,L}-{hex}. Login form uses testIDs input-email, input-password, submit-auth (NOT login-email/login-password).
